desc: Formalize the model: black region = {(x,y): y <= a[x]}, a non-increasing; per-row L[x] = max y among B (else 0), U[x] = min y among W minus 1 (else N).
Aggregate the M constraints with dictionaries keyed by row (N up to 1e9, so use dicts, not arrays).

Establish correctness condition: feasible iff for every constrained row r, max L over rows >= r <= U[r] (suffix-max vs per-row U check); equivalent to pairwise conflict condition (no black (x1,y1), white (x2,y2) with x1>=x2 and y1>=y2).
Verify logic on samples: sample 2 → W(1,2) gives U=1, B(2,2) gives L=2, suffix max at row 1 is 2 > 1 → No ✓; sample 3 → L=0, U=0 → Yes ✓.
Write final Python solution: fast stdin reading, per-row dict aggregation, sort constrained rows, suffix-max scan from bottom row upward, print Yes/No; sanity-checked against samples 1 and 4.
